## Selected Projects

### ScholarAgent — Multi-Agent Research Assistant (Jan – Mar 2025)
A LangGraph pipeline that reads 10K+ papers, grades its own answers, and refuses to hallucinate. 7-node state machine: router, retriever, grader, rewriter, generator, hallucination-check, responder. ChromaDB over 10K+ arXiv/PubMed abstracts with HF sentence-transformer embeddings. Gemini does final synthesis with citation spans. 30% drop in unsupported claims vs. plain RAG baseline. Corrective RAG loop re-queries when grader fails. Next.js + FastAPI UI streams responses with per-claim source links.
Tech: LangGraph, ChromaDB, Gemini, FastAPI, Next.js 14, TypeScript
Source: github.com/shinegami-2002/scholar-agent

### MCP Healthcare Server — Model Context Protocol Server (Feb – Mar 2025)
Six healthcare tools any MCP-compatible LLM can call, wired to four federal APIs (openFDA, PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, NLM). Drug safety lookup, clinical trial search, ICD-10 resolution, PubMed search, drug-interaction checks, medical term lookups. Async httpx with retries, schema validation on every response. Fully typed, documented, and covered by integration tests.
Tech: Python, FastMCP, httpx, openFDA, PubMed, NLM
Source: github.com/shinegami-2002/mcp-healthcare-server

### LinkVault — Go REST API Platform (Mar 2025)
Production-grade link-saving API with JWT + API key dual auth, Redis-backed sliding-window rate limiter, Postgres full-text search with tsvector indexes. Sub-50ms p95 on search over 100k synthetic links. Zero-downtime migrations, structured logging, graceful shutdown. End-to-end tests covering auth flows and rate-limit behavior.
Tech: Go, Chi v5, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT, Docker
Source: github.com/shinegami-2002/linkvault

### Distributed Task Queue — Go, gRPC, Kubernetes (Feb – Mar 2025)
Celery-style task queue built from scratch in Go. gRPC + Protobuf service interface between producers / workers / dispatcher. Redis sorted sets as priority queue. Postgres for durable state. Deployed on K8s with Helm charts; HPA scales workers on custom Prometheus metric (queue depth). Priority + retry + dead-letter semantics, no dropped work.
Tech: Go, gRPC, Protobuf, Redis, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Helm
Source: github.com/shinegami-2002/distributed-task-queue

### Representational Fingerprinting in Pruned Networks — CSC 591/791, NC State (Spring 2026)
Showed that magnitude pruning leaves a detectable, behaviorally meaningful "fingerprint" inside a neural network's representations — even when accuracy stays the same. 11 ResNet-18 configurations on CIFAR-100 with matched accuracy (only 1.48pp spread), but internal representations diverged significantly (CKA 0.73–0.95). CKA predicts which models share mistakes (Pearson r = +0.949) and which disagree (r = −0.964). Linear probe identifies pruning schedule from a single image's activations at 89.2% accuracy (chance = 25%). Multi-seed experiments, random-zeroing controls, 100K-permutation Mantel tests.
Lead author contributions: PyTorch training pipeline, H100 training schedule design, all core analyses (linear-CKA, error-geometry, decodability, divergence-trajectory), all paper figures, statistical controls, and paper write-up.
Tech: PyTorch, ResNet-18, CIFAR-100, Linear CKA, Mantel Test, 3× NVIDIA H100 (RunPod), scikit-learn, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib

### LLM-Driven Procedural Content Generation — AAAI 2026 (2025)
Using open-source LLMs (Phi-3, Gemma-2, Qwen-2.5) to generate playable game levels with constraint satisfaction checks. Trained a ViT to score generated levels on playability and structure. Model-agnostic prompt compiler with swappable backbones. Competition submission for LLMs4PCG @ AAAI 2026.
Tech: Phi-3, Gemma-2, Qwen-2.5, Prompt Engineering, ViT, PCG

### AI ChatBot — Multi-Provider LLM Service (Jan – Apr 2025)
Provider-agnostic chat backend with graceful failover across OpenAI, Groq, and others. FastAPI + LangChain orchestration, async APIs, circuit-breaker-style provider failover. Transparent failover — user never sees a provider go down. Clean separation of provider adapters, add a new one in ~30 lines.
Tech: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Docker, Node.js, Groq
Source: github.com/shinegami-2002/AI_ChatBot
